# Version 4.150.6 (Unreleased)
> **GPU failure handling**

## Highlights

The 4.150.6 snapshot improves Ganesh handling of failed render tasks and buffer uploads.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Render-task failure propagation** — Separates whether a task executed from whether it succeeded so native flush handling can recognize task and intermediate submission failures. Existing managed flush signatures are unchanged. ([#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258))
- **Buffer upload checks** — Adds checks that reject affected draws after GPU buffer upload failures under memory pressure and retains CPU triangulation data for later upload attempts; this does not establish complete upload-failure coverage. ([#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323))
